faq.q: How much does Lebedin Kofman charge?
faq.a: Lebedin Kofman publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Lebedin Kofman offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Lebedin Kofman publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Lebedin Kofman have offices?
faq.a: Lebedin Kofman publishes one office, in Manhattan. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Lebedin Kofman?
faq.a: Lebedin Kofman names four attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 3 of 4 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 1 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Lebedin Kofman?
faq.a: Lebedin Kofman scores 67 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, entity registration, website and footprint. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
